title: Cold Coal & Sealed Ink
subtitle: Outer Ward Audit
summary: Myra rides in from the south track with an unsealed warning. Inspect the guild hall and Orsen's cold forge to uncover why winter coal never arrived.

c1_start.speaker: torrik
c1_start.text: Fourteen iron carts signed out under High Quarter ink, and only nine tallies on our gate slate. Either my arithmetic failed after midnight, or someone is shaving five wagons off the ledger.

c1_myra_bursts_in.speaker: myra
c1_myra_bursts_in.text: Spoiler for your inkwell, Torrik—your arithmetic is fine. The south road watch hasn't seen a single winter grain wagon since Tuesday.

c1_torrik_reply.speaker: torrik
c1_torrik_reply.text: Myra? You're soaked to the knees. Wait—if no wagons crossed the south gate, why does the High Quarter dispatch chest claim full delivery?

c1_myra_banter.speaker: myra
c1_myra_banter.text: Because paper never gets stuck in river mud, clerk. Put down that pen and look closely at the room before we walk over to Orsen's forge.

c1_hall_inspect.speaker: torrik
c1_hall_inspect.text: Click the glowing points across the hall to inspect the quota board, the sealed dispatch chest, and Myra's mud-caked satchel.

investigation.prompt: Inspect at least 2 clues in the Small Guild Hall

hotspots.label: Quota Chalkboard
hotspots.speaker: torrik
hotspots.text: Every outer post tally is struck through in fresh chalk—and someone re-numbered carts ten through fourteen in a tighter hand.

hotspots.label: Dispatch Wax Seal
hotspots.speaker: torrik
hotspots.text: Look under the crimson wax—knife scrapes! The High Quarter seal was pressed on AFTER the tonnage figure was altered.

hotspots.label: Myra's Muddy Satchel
hotspots.speaker: myra
hotspots.text: Pale grey river clay—not mountain gravel. Whatever convoy left town tonight turned west toward the river lockhouse, not up the pass.

c1_forge_arrive.speaker: orsen
c1_forge_arrive.text: Hold right there on the threshold. If you two came with another polite High Quarter requisition, shove it straight into the cold ashes.

c1_forge_myra_quips.speaker: myra
c1_forge_myra_quips.text: Good evening to you too, Orsen. Torrik didn't come to bill you—he thinks someone stole five carts of your coal before they cleared the market gate.

c1_forge_orsen_skeptic.speaker: orsen
c1_forge_orsen_skeptic.text: Then don't stand there guessing with clean boots. Look around my floor yourself and tell me what you see.

c1_forge_inspect.speaker: orsen
c1_forge_inspect.text: Inspect the forge hearth, tool rack, and cracked wagon axle to verify Orsen's missing coal shipments.

hotspots.label: Cold Coal Hearth
hotspots.speaker: orsen
hotspots.text: Half slate rubble, wet to the core. Four apprentices are freezing because the Quartermaster's bins sent us quarry sweepings instead of anthracite.

hotspots.label: Branded Wagon Axle
hotspots.speaker: torrik
hotspots.text: Wait—this snapped axle bears a River Lockhouse harbor punch beneath the iron rim! Why was a river freight cart hauling ward iron?

hotspots.label: Anvil & Scrap Tally
hotspots.speaker: myra
hotspots.text: Orsen's been reforging bent plowshares just to keep horses shod. Whoever took the real iron left the Outer Ward bare.

c1_orsen_choice.speaker: torrik
c1_orsen_choice.text: Orsen leans over his anvil, waiting to see whether I treat him as a suspect or an ally.

choices.label: Open my private ledger openly and ask Orsen to co-sign the tally
Keep the official guild ledger sealed until Myra verifies the river track

c1_branch_open.speaker: orsen
c1_branch_open.text: Hmph. First clerk in five years with spine enough to show his own ink. Give me that pen—I'm marking my hammer stamp beside every missing cart.

c1_branch_open_myra.speaker: myra
c1_branch_open_myra.text: Now we look like a proper audit team. Grab a heavy coat, Orsen—the rain outside isn't waiting for sunrise.

c1_branch_cautious.speaker: orsen
c1_branch_cautious.text: Careful with your little wax rules, clerk. Still—since Myra vouches for you, I'll bring my pry-bar and see those tracks with my own eyes.

c1_rainy_street.speaker: myra
c1_rainy_street.text: Look down by the gutter cobblestones! Deep iron-rimmed ruts cutting straight away from the south gate toward the dry valley road.

c1_rainy_orsen.speaker: orsen
c1_rainy_orsen.text: Four-inch tire width, loaded past the hubs. That's our Outer Ward pig iron rolling toward the river lockhouse under cover of storm.

c1_end.speaker: torrik
c1_end.text: We follow those tracks at first light before the mud dries or the barges cast off. Chapter 1 complete—onward to the valley road.
